name: Used Car Value Retention / Residual Calculator

map.🧮 二手车保值率/残值计算: 🧮 Used Car Residual Value / Retention Rate
map.输入购车价、车龄、里程、品牌与车况，按贬值曲线计算当前估值与保值率，并预测未来: Enter purchase price, age, mileage, brand and condition to compute the current valuation and retention rate along a depreciation curve, and forecast the residual value change over the next 5 years.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：value÷price×100；Math.floor: Core formula (by input variable): value÷price×100; Math.floor(age)
map.📖 查看「二手车保值率/残值计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Used Car Residual Value / Retention Rate User Guide"
map.💡 估值 = 新车价 × 贬值系数 × 品牌系数 × 车况系数 × 里程修正；首: 💡 Valuation = new price × depreciation factor × brand factor × condition factor × mileage correction; about 15% depreciation in the first year, then about 9% per year thereafter.
map.估值模型为经验估算，实际成交受车型、配置、地区、市场行情影响: The valuation model is an empirical estimate; actual transaction is affected by model, configuration, region and market conditions
map.新能源车因电池衰减与换代快，保值率通常低于同级别燃油车: NEVs usually have lower retention than same-class fuel cars due to battery degradation and fast generational change
map.事故车/泡水车/调表车残值大幅折损，需专业评估: Accident / flooded / odometer-rolled cars lose value sharply and need professional assessment
map.结果仅供参考，不作为定价或交易唯一依据: Results are for reference only and are not the sole basis for pricing or trading
map.📚 深度解析：二手车保值率/残值计算: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Used Car Residual Value / Retention Rate
map.购车前估算某车开 N 年后的残值，对比不同品牌/车况的保值率，辅助选车与卖车决策: Before buying, estimate the residual value after owning a car for N years, compare retention rates across brands / conditions, and assist car selection and selling decisions.
map.卖车时根据车龄、里程、品牌与车况反推当前合理估值，避免被压价。: When selling, reverse-engineer a reasonable current valuation from age, mileage, brand and condition to avoid being underpriced.
map.做 5 年持有成本测算：把每年预测残值连乘折旧系数，估算总折旧损失。: Do a 5-year holding-cost projection: multiply the yearly forecast residual by the depreciation factor to estimate total depreciation loss.
map.以「购车价 20 万、车龄 5 年、里程 8 万 km、合资品牌、车况良好、年基: Example: purchase price 200k CNY, age 5 years, mileage 80k km, mainstream JV brand, good condition, annual base mileage 20k km
map.保值率系数：车龄保留率 retained(5)=0.85×0.91⁴≈0.582: Retention coefficients: age retention retained(5)=0.85×0.91⁴≈0.5829; brand factor JV=1.05; good condition=1.00; mileage factor mileageFactor=base 100k / actual 80k=0.8<1 → 1+(1-0.8)×0.05=1.01. Residual=200000×0.5829×1.05×1.00×1.01≈123,600 CNY, retention=123600/200000=61.82%. If domestic brand (0.90) under the same caliber, residual drops to about 106k, showing the brand's significant effect on retention.
map.保值率为何逐年加速下降？: Why does the retention rate accelerate downward year by year?
map.模型用 retained(age)=0.85×0.91^(age-1)，即首年保: The model uses retained(age)=0.85×0.91^(age-1), i.e. about 85% retained in the first year, then ×0.91 each year thereafter, a compound decline; depreciation is fast in the first few years and slows later, matching most models' actual residual curve. It is only an empirical estimate; in reality it is heavily affected by new-car price cuts, policy (such as emission standards) and supply-demand in the used-car market.
map.里程系数怎么算？: How is the mileage factor calculated?
map.预期里程=年基准里程×车龄；实际/预期>1（超里程）时系数下修，最多降到 0.7: Expected mileage = annual base mileage × age; when actual / expected > 1 (over mileage) the factor is revised down, to a floor of 0.70; when actual / expected < 1 (under mileage) the factor is revised up, to a ceiling of 1.05. The more over mileage, the greater the residual loss, which is exactly the theoretical basis for leasing return charging by excess mileage.
map.二手车保值率与残值估算工具，结合贬值曲线、品牌溢价、车况与里程修正，计算当前估值: Used car residual value and retention-rate estimation tool; combining the depreciation curve, brand premium, condition and mileage correction, it computes the current valuation and retention rate and forecasts the 5-year residual trend.
